verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub evidence confirm multi-modal ingestion of PDFs, images (with OCR), and other files, with type-specific extraction (super-rag/content-types), and recall via document search, hybrid search, and memory graph traversal makes stored file content retrievable later. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of file/image recall accuracy and no community corroboration beyond a complaint about large link content (not files specifically).
